# Overview

`Atlas3` is an R client for OHDSI ATLAS 3.0 and WebAPI 3.0. It discovers the
WebAPI root from an ATLAS URL, checks the server version, authenticates, and
provides typed access to sources, vocabularies, concept sets, cohort
definitions, cohort definition sets, CDM results, jobs, and analyses.

# Connecting

```{r}
library(Atlas3)

atlas <- connectAtlas("https://atlas.example.org")
atlas
```

Discovery tries the common layouts: `/WebAPI`, `/webapi`, a direct WebAPI
root, and `/atlas/WebAPI`. The client refuses WebAPI 2.x.

If the deployment uses database authentication, log in once. The client
creates a personal API key (returned only once by WebAPI) and stores it in the
OS keyring when available.

```{r}
atlas$login("my.user", "my.password")
atlas$whoami()
```

Existing keys can be supplied directly:

```{r}
atlas <- connectAtlas("https://atlas.example.org", apiKey = "wa_...")
```

# Sources and vocabulary

```{r}
sources <- atlas$sources$list()
vapply(sources, `[[`, "", "sourceKey")

concepts <- atlas$concepts$search("EUNOMIA", "diclofenac", rows = 10)
counts <- atlas$concepts$counts("EUNOMIA", c(1124300))
counts[[1]]$recordCount
```

# Concept sets

```{r}
conceptSet <- atlas$conceptSets$createFromConcepts(
  "Diclofenac ingredients", c(1124300),
  sourceKey = "EUNOMIA", includeDescendants = TRUE
)
expression <- atlas$conceptSets$expression(conceptSet$id)
resolved <- atlas$concepts$resolve("EUNOMIA", expression)
```

# Cohort definitions

```{r}
demo <- atlas$cohorts$get(1)
cohort <- atlas$cohorts$create("My cohort", demo$expression)
atlas$cohorts$sql(demo$expression)
job <- atlas$cohorts$generate(cohort$id, "EUNOMIA")
atlas$jobs$wait(job, timeout = 600)
```

# Cohort definition sets

A cohort definition set bundle contains cohort expressions and all embedded
concept sets, with a SHA-256 integrity digest.

```{r}
atlas$cohortSets$export(path = "my-cohorts.zip")
result <- atlas$cohortSets$import("my-cohorts.zip", onConflict = "rename")
result$createdCohorts
```

`onConflict` can be `"error"`, `"skip"`, `"rename"` (default), or `"update"`.

# Every endpoint

The bundled catalog contains every WebAPI 3.0 operation. The typed methods
cover common workflows; `call()` reaches the rest.

```{r}
length(atlas$endpoints())
atlas$call("cohortdefinition.getCohortDefinitionRaw", id = 1)
atlas$request("GET", "/cohortdefinition/1/info")
```

# Session information

```{r}
sessionInfo()
```
